mapDemo.title: Public services in Maramureș
mapDemo.intro: I'm from Maramureș, so I picked my home county for this demo. It's an interactive map of public institutions, the kind of GIS interface I build every day for the public sector: filters, search, a list kept in sync with the map, and the nearest institution with a route to it.
mapDemo.disclaimer: A small demo built for this portfolio with public OpenStreetMap data. It isn't a real product and uses nothing from the projects I work on; some institutions may be missing or incomplete.
mapDemo.hint: Click anywhere on the map or use your location to find the nearest institution.
mapDemo.straightLine: in a straight line (the routing service didn't answer)
mapDemo.outsideCounty: You're outside Maramureș. Pick a point on the map instead.
mapDemo.locationDenied: Couldn't get your location. Pick a point on the map instead.
mapDemo.source: Data © OpenStreetMap contributors · Routes: OSRM · Map: CARTO
